nuggets.text: The Blue Raiders name won a 1934 newspaper contest; Charles Sarver got $5 and admitted borrowing from Colgate's "Red Raiders."
Blue Raiders coach Derek Mason led Vanderbilt when Sarah Fuller became the first woman to play in a game for a Power Five team.
The Blue Raiders' opening rout of Murray State was their highest-scoring game of the Derek Mason era.
The Blue Raiders' 38-14 win over Murray State was weather-shortened, so the opener never reached its final whistle.
Blue Raiders receiver Cam'ron Lacy opened the season with eight catches for 118 yards and a touchdown.
Blue Raiders QB Roman Gagliano threw for 1,005 yards and seven TDs in just three starts to close 2025.
The Blue Raiders make their first-ever trip to play Kansas this season.
The Blue Raiders play three midweek CUSA games this year, including a "$2 Tuesday" home game against Delaware.
The Blue Raiders and Marshall first met in the 1992 I-AA playoffs; Saturday is their 13th meeting.
Floyd Stadium opened in 1933 and is named for Johnny "Red" Floyd, who coached the Blue Raiders from 1935-38.
